notes: panda_control step5b (src/step5b_cart_pose.cpp), the excitation behind their v1 fit. A single slow z-sine with orientation held at the anchor. Reached here through the v3_step5d builder with every other amplitude zeroed and high_band_ratio 0, which leaves the z low band alone: 0.30 Hz from panda_traj.POS_FREQS, against upstream's 0.25 Hz -- the band is a module constant, not a spec parameter. Ramp-IN only, so the episode ends mid-swing.
name: step5b
track_abort_note: panda_control's step5c/step5d collector values. Orientation is held, so the rotation abort cannot bind.
